pages_ranges.description: List of page range strings (e.g., ['1-5', '8-12']) for targeted comparison. Required only when comparing non-sequential or renumbered pages.

highlight_added.description: Color to use for highlighting added text (e.g., 'cyan', 'yellow', '#00ff00').

highlight_deleted.description: Color to use for highlighting deleted text (e.g., 'red', 'magenta', '#ff0000').

highlight_replaced.description: Color to use for highlighting replaced text (e.g., 'magenta', 'blue', '#ff00ff').

exclude_rects.description: List of rectangle specs (x1,y1,x2,y2) to exclude from comparison, e.g., ['0,0,100,50'] for header exclusion.

output_report.description: Output file path for the generated diff report (PDF or text). If empty, no report is produced.

file1.description: Path to first PDF file (required positional argument).

file2.description: Path to second PDF file (required positional argument).
